game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Ash Rim Trail Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before magma slimes spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: In Ash Rim Trail, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before magma slimes spring the trap. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the fire warden ahead. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the magma valve by solving code steps involving predictions that move the fire warden forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the magma valve first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mixed Type Oracle' (Week 2 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Ash Rim Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
